prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: a white fillet dredged through flour with one swipe and laid into foaming butter, an immediate gentle roar, edges lacing gold. The camera holds as it flips to reveal a delicate golden crust. Capers rain into the butter and pop like tiny fireworks, lemon squeezed straight in — juice hissing. Money shot: the pale silky sauce spooned over the fillet in repeated glossy bastes, then a fork pressing down — the fish flaking open in snow-white layers with steam escaping, backlit, in extreme macro. Final beat: plated with the caper butter pooling, lemon slice laid over. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the butter roar, then the caper pops. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
